title: Anchors to fuzzify
description: A non-empty array with one entry per anchor to fuzzify (convert from a strict to a fuzzy selector), each identifying the anchor by the target anchorable definition file holding it and its slot index.

definitionFilePath.description: Absolute path of the target anchorable definition file holding the anchor, with forward slashes (a backslash is a JSON escape). A relative path resolves against the CLI working directory, not --project-dir.

index.description: Zero-based anchor slot of the definition; it must point at an existing anchor.
